verdict.rationale: Docs include multiple named cookbooks covering real end-to-end tasks—LLM guardrails screening, hierarchical document classification, retrieval reranking, citation/hallucination checking, and parallel question batching with quantified cost/accuracy results—going beyond single-call snippets. missing for 10: no independent/hands-on confirmation that these cookbooks are fully runnable end-to-end code (evidence only shows descriptive summaries, not full code walkthroughs), and no third-party corroboration of their completeness.
